Editing videos with Claude Code, explained.
Rohan films reels for his shop. Editing each one takes him two hours.
And it's the same edits every time. Trim the pauses. Add his logo. Add a title. Export for Instagram.
Now meet a second Rohan. He teaches Claude Code those edits once, as a Skill.
Step one. Make a folder. Raw clips go in one folder, your logo in another.
Step two. Install Claude Code, and F F mpeg, the free tool that does the actual cutting.
Step three. Open the folder in your terminal, type claude, and log in.
Step four. Ask Claude to make the Skill. Describe your edits in plain words.
Claude saves it as a file in your folder, so it remembers next time.
Now Rohan just types: slash reel editor, and the clip's name. Claude runs F F mpeg, and saves the reel.
Two hours of editing, down to about ten minutes of checking.
To be fair, watch every reel before posting. If something's off, tell Claude, and ask it to update the Skill.
Teach the edit once. Post every day.
